# Learnwithpugazh

> Learnwithpugazh is an educational platform created by Pugazhmani K for learning cybersecurity, AI, networking, Linux, programming, and software development through structured learning resources, tutorials, projects, and practical guides.

## Main Pages

- [Home](https://learnwithpugazh.vercel.app/)
- [Learning](https://learnwithpugazh.vercel.app/learning)
- [Projects](https://learnwithpugazh.vercel.app/projects)
- [Blog](https://learnwithpugazh.vercel.app/blog)
- [About](https://learnwithpugazh.vercel.app/about)
- [Contact](https://learnwithpugazh.vercel.app/contact)

## Learning Resources

Structured technical learning content covering cybersecurity, AI/ML, programming, tools & DevOps. Browse by category filter on the Learning page.

- [Cybersecurity](https://learnwithpugazh.vercel.app/learning?category=Cybersecurity)
- [AI & ML](https://learnwithpugazh.vercel.app/learning?category=AI%20%26%20ML)
- [Programming](https://learnwithpugazh.vercel.app/learning?category=Programming)
- [Tools & DevOps](https://learnwithpugazh.vercel.app/learning?category=Tools%20%26%20DevOps)
- [All Resources](https://learnwithpugazh.vercel.app/learning)

## Projects

Security platforms, AI systems, and full-stack products built by Pugazhmani K.

- [View Projects](https://learnwithpugazh.vercel.app/projects)

## Blog

Technical articles and insights covering cybersecurity, AI engineering, and software development.

- [Read Blog](https://learnwithpugazh.vercel.app/blog)

## Admin Panel

Protected content management panel (Firebase Auth required) for managing blog posts and learning topics.

- [Admin Login](https://learnwithpugazh.vercel.app/admin/login)
- [Admin Dashboard](https://learnwithpugazh.vercel.app/admin)

## PDF Learning Resources

Upload and view PDF study materials directly in the browser using an inline PDF viewer (pdf.js / pdfjs-dist).

## Content Guidelines

The website provides educational and technical content intended for learning, experimentation, and project development in cybersecurity and AI engineering.
